A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

Wolf Trail Home

  1. Draw a safe trail with the Bone. Lead the Wolves around danger and back to the camp.
  2. BONE TRAIL. Draw, then WALK.
  3. Points, progress and the next target stay visible. END saves a result. Retry starts fresh.
